$comment: Named, versioned machine-verification suite for cinatra-ai/cinatra — the gate-arm half of the truthful verification-record model (the Truthful Attribution protocol §4). The truthful-attribution-gate reads THIS file at the merged SHA (authoritative, no TOCTOU) when a merge record carries a Gate-suite arm: the cited suiteId@version must equal this file's, the Accountable trailer must equal accountable{github,name,email}, and every requiredContexts entry must have concluded success on the reviewed head. highRiskPaths EXTENDS the central cinatra-ai/ci defaults (the gate verifies the effective set is a superset). High-risk changes (this file is itself one — see **/gate-suite.json in the defaults) require the HUMAN arm at tier=maintainer; the gate arm alone is rejected, so this file's birth carries a maintainer Reviewed-by, not a self-blessing gate arm. lastAuditedAt + auditEvidence are the §4 monthly-audit record; the Accountable engineer re-audits monthly and bumps BOTH coupled in one commit (the gate warns >35d, fails the gate arm >65d; the human arm is always still available).
auditEvidence: 2026-07-10 high-risk-glob gap closure (cinatra#1289 / cinatra#1293): the S0 credential-store capability-ownership GRANT primitive (cinatra#1289) is a credential trust boundary the owner reserved for security review, yet NONE of its changed paths matched any highRiskPath, so the machine gate classified it normal-risk (only the reviewer's manual hold kept it gated). The grant primitive is a flat src/lib leaf (extension-capability-ownership-grants.ts), its bootstrap DDL is an additive .ts leaf (extension-grant-schema.ts) not migrations/**|schema.sql, and the host-port grant surface it extends (extension-host-port-grants.ts) shares the same evasion — the existing extension globs anchor on capability-registry/ / trust-gate/ DIRECTORIES, which these leaves are not under. Added TWO precise highRiskPaths (EXTENDS the central defaults; supersede check unaffected): '**/extension-*grant*' (covers the grant primitive, the extension-grant-schema.ts DDL leaf, extension-host-port-grants.ts, and the existing extension-install-grant-context.ts sibling) and '**/*capability-ownership*' (anti-rename hardening for the primitive/test + the future S1 consuming resolver keeping the domain term). Precision verified with minimatch against the branch tree: the pair matches ONLY the grant leaves and their tests (7 paths) with no over-match of unrelated src/lib/*store*.ts files. DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED: src/lib/drizzle-store.ts (4564-LOC general store carrying host-port grant DDL inline) — a wholesale glob would mark every store edit high-risk (approval fatigue); the codebase's own mitigation is to EXTRACT grant DDL into extension-*grant* leaves, which the new glob covers. Codex converged the glob set MERGE-SAFE (ran minimatch to confirm coverage). version 2026.07.3->2026.07.4 per the version-bump-on-content-change rule below; requiredContexts[].pinned UNCHANGED (no gate-engine/pin change). Prior record (2026-07-06) merge_group activation (engineering#484): 'merge_group' added to the truthful-attribution requiredContexts entry's allowedEvents (pull_request/push unchanged; the engine's WF-id F1 check is opt-in and fail-closed on malformed values, so widening the array only ADMITS the new event, never weakens the existing ones), version 2026.07.2->2026.07.3 per the version-bump-on-content-change rule below; requiredContexts[].pinned values are UNCHANGED and re-verified: source-leak pinned 45826486 (a direct descendant of the merge_group-capable engine ci#59 @c3bc633 — delta is exactly ci#60, the content/diff staleness binding) and truthful-attribution pinned 0d42bca (= 45826486 + ci#63 API pagination fix; contains c3bc633). Caller triggers: merge_group added to all 5 required org-gate callers (truthful-attribution, source-leak, skills-drift, ui-design-system, secrets-required) and to crm-migration-gate (the one remaining branch-protection required context without coverage), all inert until a merge queue exists (engineering#485). Coverage guard added: scripts/ci/merge-group-coverage-guard.mjs (+ vitest suite in the root gate of record) fails CI when any mirrored required context or suite requiredContexts entry lacks merge_group coverage. KNOWN LIMIT, on record: the truthful-attribution reusable ENGINE at pin 0d42bca has no merge_group pre-merge arm — on a merge_group event the context concludes green without re-verifying the synthetic candidate (the fail-closed post-merge push arm still validates every landed record); a real engine merge_group arm + pin advance is REQUIRED before Path-A queue enablement. Prior record (2026-07-03): re-pin (cinatra-ai/ci gate-caller realign to ci main @45826486a3965bc8ebd6203a26330ad0dc1ae511): all three ci gate callers (truthful-attribution, source-leak, skills-drift) advanced to the same-SHA double-pin uses:@45826486 + with.ref 45826486, rolling out the merged ci engine fixes (cinatra-ai/ci#56 skills-drift push-arm PR-body ack, cinatra-ai/ci#58 source-leak public-strict profile availability, cinatra-ai/ci#59 merge_group diff base — inert without a merge queue, cinatra-ai/ci#60 approval-staleness content/diff binding). requiredContexts[].pinned must equal the SHA referenced_workflows reports for each caller's uses:@ (the gate matches exactly, fail closed), so both entries move 83ca29ef->45826486 in this same commit (version 2026.06.5->2026.07.1). Audit basis: the reusable truthful-attribution-gate workflow YAML is byte-identical 83ca29ef..45826486; config/high-risk-defaults.json is unchanged 0de02f3..45826486 (the 2026.06.5 superset entries still satisfy the engine); the post-merge push arm was audited live on main (runs on every push, enforce mode fail-closed, genuine record violations red-flagged and corrected during 2026-07-02/03). 45826486 is a clean descendant of 83ca29ef on cinatra-ai/ci main; protected by the high-risk-path review on .github/workflows/** and **/gate-suite.json. version is bumped whenever the pinned content changes (suiteId@version must be immutable per content). Prior record (2026-06-28): callers realigned 7e6e94c9->83ca29ef via PR #637/#646 (source-leak, version 2026.06.2->2026.06.3) and PR #638 (truthful-attribution, version 2026.06.3->2026.06.4).
